thesisQuality.note: Strong evidence of real hyperscale/HPC demand, contracted revenue and accelerated delivery supports a strong band, tempered by unproven stabilized economics.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Execution improved with early delivery and funded projects, but Q2 revenue of $25M, negative $30M adjusted EBITDA and about $6.016B debt keep the assessment mixed.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: Approximately $7.61B market capitalization is demanding against negative current adjusted EBITDA, high leverage and still-unobserved stabilized HPC cash yields.

catalystScore.note: Multiple source-supported catalysts include phased HPC delivery/rent commencement, Stingray funding and a 900 MW option, though timing and conversion remain execution-dependent.

governancePower.note: Management has demonstrated financing and ahead-of-schedule initial delivery, but the evidence set does not establish exceptional long-duration capital-allocation stewardship.

alignment2036.note: Large-scale energized data-center capacity and AI/HPC hosting address a durable compute-infrastructure need across plausible 2036 futures.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Cipher can reuse power/interconnection and development capabilities across bitcoin and HPC/data-center demand, but transition concentration remains meaningful.

bottleneckControl.note: Large energized sites, interconnection positions and development pipeline participate in scarce power-to-compute infrastructure, but construction/interconnection remain successor bottlenecks.

scenarioRobustness.note: HPC diversification reduces pure bitcoin dependence, but leverage, construction timing and tenant delivery conditions leave material scenario concentration.

substitutionResilience.note: Grid access and tenant-ready infrastructure have meaningful replacement friction, while competing data-center developers and alternative sites remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Project financing and multiple sites improve execution options, but grid/interconnection, construction and equipment dependencies remain material.

pricingPower.note: Long-duration contracted HPC revenue and Google-backed tenant obligations support economic visibility, but stabilized margins and broad-cycle price pass-through are not yet demonstrated.

risk.note: Material leverage, construction/delivery timing, tenant remedies and transitional bitcoin exposure create above-average execution risk despite funded projects and contracted demand.

confidence.note: Identity/tradability and core operating/debt facts are supported by current SEC and issuer primary sources, with an independent current market-cap source; future stabilized campus economics remain unknown rather than assumed.

thesis: Cipher is converting scarce power/interconnection and data-center development capability into long-duration AI/HPC infrastructure revenue, creating a credible diversification path from bitcoin mining if delivery and financing execution hold.
keyRisk: High leverage and construction obligations precede fully stabilized HPC cash generation, making delays or weaker tenant economics disproportionately damaging.
nextCatalyst: Further phased HPC capacity delivery and rent commencement, plus evidence that funded campuses convert contracted demand into durable positive cash generation.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the methodology-weighted component score; risk and dataConfidence are reported separately for downstream locked risk/confidence treatment.
